focus: Traceability: shared references and docs for stale workflowMode strings

findingDetails.title: sk-design shared creation-contract example uses stale workflowMode "interface"
findingDetails.claim: The typed context envelope JSON example still uses the pre-rename "workflowMode": "interface". This is a live shared reference consumed by modes and can mislead implementers.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replace with "sk-design-interface" and update the surrounding prose if it references the old name.

findingDetails.title: sk-design-mcp-open-design CLI pairing example references pre-rename packet name
findingDetails.claim: The childLoadedSkills example lists "design-mcp-open-design" instead of the renamed "sk-design-mcp-open-design".
findingDetails.recommendation: Update the JSON example and any associated commentary to the new packet name.

findingDetails.title: sk-design manual-testing playbook uses old design mode names in pass/fail criteria
findingDetails.claim: The FAIL criteria list the pre-rename design-judgment modes "interface/foundations/motion/audit/md-generator". These names no longer exist in the registry and could confuse test operators.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update the criteria to sk-design-interface, sk-design-md-generator, and remove or remap the legacy foundations/motion/audit labels.
